intent: I have written every living call sign I heard on the storm-shelter wall, but none of them answered twice. I do not tell the new station that yet. I ask for a safe check-in time, a second frequency if this one fails, and one piece of regional information that proves I am speaking with a real local operator rather than a recording or trap. Hope makes me talk; experience makes me verify.
emotion: tired but alert, guarded, relieved to hear another station
